title: Legacy UAP program rotten and breaking as insiders defect

tellings.quote: the disclosure as being this kind of recognition that the legacy program is rotten basically in more ways than one, maybe bureaucratically institutionally, maybe also morally rotten and it it may be in the process of breaking basically, right? Everyone's defecting out of it, right? That's what seems to be happening.

plain: Matthew Pines, an analyst, tells Jesse Michels on his podcast that the push for disclosure in the 2020s is a recognition that the legacy program, a long-running secret effort on UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs), is rotten in more ways than one. He says it may be rotten as an institution and also morally, and that it seems to be breaking as everyone defects from it. If true, it would explain why insiders are now coming forward.
